name: phellodendrine + sophora flavescens root
purpose: Uses ·Helps relieve itching and discomfort associated with hemorrhoids. ·Temporarily shrinks hemorrhoids and relieves burning and pain. . Soothes and protects irritated tissue.
uses: Directions: Use 2 to 3 times a day, one application per dose. When practical, cleanse the affected area with mild soap and warmwater, rinse thoroughly.Dry the area by gently patting or blotting witha tissue or soft cloth before application. Apply half of the gel in the applicator to the external affected area ifexterna symptoms are present.
